{{Leo}}
Leo 28 is the 252nd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 28th day of Leo, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 36, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 9宮28日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 252|Chapter 252]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152271}}.
